# API Arena — extended reference

This file adds the Spanish answers, doc summaries, and the public preview text of each seeded challenge. It does not include endpoint contracts, hidden tests, or hints.

## English

### What is API Arena?

API Arena is a free competitive platform for students, self-taught backend developers, and teachers. You choose a challenge, build a real Spring Boot REST API, and upload the project as a ZIP. An isolated sandbox builds and runs that API, then real HTTP tests score it. It is measured practice, not a slide-only course.

### How does scoring work?

Each submission is scored out of 1000. Up to 800 points come from technical HTTP tests against the running API: functional correctness (300), performance (300), and REST design (200). Up to 200 points come from an AI review. The default review rubric is heuristic, and a language-model provider can be enabled per environment. XP tracks cumulative progress. ELO is a separate competitive rating that moves against the score expected for your rating and the challenge difficulty. Submitting again below your best score on that challenge is penalized.

### How do I start?

Create a free account and open the challenge catalog. Read the public preview, then sign in and start a timed session to see the full requirements. Zip a Maven project with pom.xml at the archive root and upload it. The pipeline builds the project in a sandbox, calls the API over HTTP, saves the score, and updates the leaderboard. The docs hub explains the first submission step by step.

### What does a public challenge page show?

A public challenge page is a preview only: title, description, difficulty, category, time limit, and XP reward. Endpoint lists, hidden tests, and hints are not on that page. They appear after you sign in and start a timed session.

### Who is API Arena for?

API Arena is for students learning backend APIs, developers who want measured practice, and teachers who group students and review their submissions.

## Español

### ¿Qué es API Arena?

API Arena es una plataforma competitiva y gratuita para estudiantes, desarrolladores autodidactas de backend y profesores. Eliges un challenge, construyes una API REST real con Spring Boot y subes el proyecto en un ZIP. Un sandbox aislado compila y ejecuta esa API, y tests HTTP reales la puntúan. Es práctica medida, no un curso de diapositivas.

### ¿Cómo funciona la puntuación?

Cada entrega se puntúa sobre 1000. Hasta 800 puntos salen de tests HTTP técnicos contra la API en ejecución: corrección funcional (300), rendimiento (300) y diseño REST (200). Hasta 200 puntos salen de una revisión con IA. La rúbrica por defecto es heurística, y un proveedor de modelo de lenguaje se puede activar por entorno. La XP mide el progreso acumulado. El ELO es un rating competitivo aparte, que sube o baja frente a la nota esperada para tu rating y la dificultad del challenge. Volver a enviar por debajo de tu mejor nota en ese challenge penaliza.

### ¿Cómo empiezo?

Crea una cuenta gratuita y abre el catálogo de challenges. Lee la vista previa pública, inicia sesión y arranca una sesión cronometrada para ver los requisitos completos. Empaqueta un proyecto Maven con pom.xml en la raíz del ZIP y súbelo. El pipeline compila el proyecto en un sandbox, llama a la API por HTTP, guarda la nota y actualiza el ranking. El centro de docs explica la primera entrega paso a paso.

### ¿Qué muestra la página pública de un challenge?

La página pública de un challenge es solo una vista previa: título, descripción, dificultad, categoría, tiempo límite y recompensa de XP. Las listas de endpoints, los tests ocultos y las pistas no están en esa página. Aparecen después de iniciar sesión y empezar una sesión cronometrada.

### ¿Para quién es API Arena?

API Arena es para estudiantes que aprenden APIs backend, desarrolladores que quieren práctica medida y profesores que agrupan alumnos y revisan sus entregas.

## Challenge previews

### Build a Bookstore API

- Difficulty: EASY
- English preview: https://apiarena.net/en/challenges/bookstore-api
- Spanish preview: https://apiarena.net/es/challenges/bookstore-api

Design a RESTful API for a bookstore. Implement endpoints to list, create, update, and delete books. Each book has a title, author, ISBN, price, and stock count. Responses must use proper HTTP status codes and JSON payloads.

### Todo List CRUD

- Difficulty: EASY
- English preview: https://apiarena.net/en/challenges/todo-crud
- Spanish preview: https://apiarena.net/es/challenges/todo-crud

Implement a complete CRUD API for a todo list application. Support creating, reading, updating, and deleting tasks. Each task has a title, description, completed flag, and priority level (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH).

### JWT Authentication Flow

- Difficulty: MEDIUM
- English preview: https://apiarena.net/en/challenges/jwt-auth-flow
- Spanish preview: https://apiarena.net/es/challenges/jwt-auth-flow

Build an authentication API that supports user registration, login with JWT tokens, token refresh, and a protected /me endpoint. Passwords must be hashed. Access tokens expire in 15 minutes; refresh tokens in 7 days.

### Rate Limiter Middleware

- Difficulty: MEDIUM
- English preview: https://apiarena.net/en/challenges/rate-limiter
- Spanish preview: https://apiarena.net/es/challenges/rate-limiter

Create an API with a configurable rate limiter. The API exposes a simple /ping endpoint. Rate limit: 100 requests per minute per IP. Return 429 Too Many Requests with a Retry-After header when exceeded.

### Paginated Product Catalog

- Difficulty: MEDIUM
- English preview: https://apiarena.net/en/challenges/paginated-catalog
- Spanish preview: https://apiarena.net/es/challenges/paginated-catalog

Build a product catalog API that supports cursor-based pagination, filtering by category and price range, and sorting by price or name. Return pagination metadata (next cursor, total count, has_more).

### Redis Cache Layer

- Difficulty: HARD
- English preview: https://apiarena.net/en/challenges/redis-cache-layer
- Spanish preview: https://apiarena.net/es/challenges/redis-cache-layer

Add a Redis caching layer to an existing articles API. Cache GET responses with a 60-second TTL. Implement cache invalidation on POST/PUT/DELETE. Expose a /cache/stats endpoint showing hit/miss ratio.

### Real-Time Chat Room

- Difficulty: HARD
- English preview: https://apiarena.net/en/challenges/realtime-chat
- Spanish preview: https://apiarena.net/es/challenges/realtime-chat

Build a WebSocket-based chat room API. Support joining/leaving rooms, broadcasting messages, and listing active users. Provide a REST endpoint to fetch message history (last 50 messages per room).

### Multi-Table Join Queries

- Difficulty: MEDIUM
- English preview: https://apiarena.net/en/challenges/multi-table-joins
- Spanish preview: https://apiarena.net/es/challenges/multi-table-joins

Design a school database API with students, courses, and enrollments. Implement endpoints that return joined data: a student with their courses, a course with enrolled students, and enrollment statistics.

### API Gateway Pattern

- Difficulty: HARD
- English preview: https://apiarena.net/en/challenges/api-gateway
- Spanish preview: https://apiarena.net/es/challenges/api-gateway

Implement a simple API gateway that routes requests to two downstream services (users-service and orders-service). Add request logging, timeout handling (3 s), and a /health endpoint that checks both services.

### Contract Testing with Pact

- Difficulty: HARD
- English preview: https://apiarena.net/en/challenges/contract-testing
- Spanish preview: https://apiarena.net/es/challenges/contract-testing

Write consumer-driven contract tests for a payments API. The API has endpoints to create a payment, get payment status, and list payments. Validate request/response schemas and status codes.

### URL Shortener Service

- Difficulty: EASY
- English preview: https://apiarena.net/en/challenges/url-shortener
- Spanish preview: https://apiarena.net/es/challenges/url-shortener

Build a URL shortener API. POST a long URL to receive a short code. GET the short code to be redirected (301). Track click count and provide an analytics endpoint that returns total clicks and referrer breakdown.

### Input Validation & Sanitization

- Difficulty: MEDIUM
- English preview: https://apiarena.net/en/challenges/input-validation
- Spanish preview: https://apiarena.net/es/challenges/input-validation

Create a user registration API with strict input validation: email format, password strength (min 8 chars, uppercase, number, special char), username (alphanumeric, 3-20 chars). Sanitize all text inputs against XSS.

### Idempotent Payment Processing API

- Difficulty: EXTREME
- English preview: https://apiarena.net/en/challenges/idempotent-payments
- Spanish preview: https://apiarena.net/es/challenges/idempotent-payments

Build a payment API that is safe to retry. Every POST /api/payments accepts an Idempotency-Key: replaying the same key must return the original payment, never a duplicate charge. Payments can be captured exactly once and expose an append-only event trail. Concurrency and double-submit must never create two charges for one key.

### Event-Sourced Banking Ledger

- Difficulty: EXTREME
- English preview: https://apiarena.net/en/challenges/event-sourced-ledger
- Spanish preview: https://apiarena.net/es/challenges/event-sourced-ledger

Implement an account ledger where the balance is never stored directly: it is a projection of an append-only transaction log. POST transactions (DEPOSIT/WITHDRAW) append events; GET /api/accounts/{id} returns the balance folded from those events. Overdrafts must be rejected and the log must stay immutable and ordered.

### Multi-Tenant RBAC SaaS API

- Difficulty: EXTREME
- English preview: https://apiarena.net/en/challenges/multi-tenant-rbac
- Spanish preview: https://apiarena.net/es/challenges/multi-tenant-rbac

Design a multi-tenant API where every resource belongs to a tenant and is invisible across tenant boundaries. Members have roles (OWNER, ADMIN, MEMBER) that gate what they can do. Listing a tenant's members must only ever return that tenant's members, and cross-tenant access must be impossible even with a valid id.

### Distributed Saga Order Orchestration

- Difficulty: EXTREME
- English preview: https://apiarena.net/en/challenges/distributed-saga-orchestration
- Spanish preview: https://apiarena.net/es/challenges/distributed-saga-orchestration

Orchestrate an order across payment, inventory and shipping steps as a saga. Creating an order runs the steps in sequence; if a later step fails, earlier steps must be compensated (rolled back) so the system ends consistent. Cancelling an in-flight order triggers compensation. A /health endpoint reports orchestrator readiness.

### High-Throughput Time-Series Ingestion

- Difficulty: EXTREME
- English preview: https://apiarena.net/en/challenges/timeseries-ingestion
- Spanish preview: https://apiarena.net/es/challenges/timeseries-ingestion

Build an ingestion API for time-series points optimized for throughput. Clients batch-write points to a series; reads return recent points and a downsampled aggregate (min/max/avg per bucket). The hot read path must stay fast and allocate little under sustained load.
